title: A script load after the host frame pump is live leaves requestAnimationFrame callbacks for the next frame tick

needles: WidgetBridge load_script data pushes defer rAF to the frame once the pump is live
WidgetBridge load_script flushes rAF before any frame pump runs

installed_sdk.rationale: WidgetBridge::load_script keeps its signature; its documented contract now defers rAF callbacks once service_frame_callbacks() has run, and frame_pump_live() is a public const query on the installed widget_bridge.hpp. Callers with no frame pump keep the synchronous flush.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or accepted document shape changes; the change is when a live UI bridge runs animation-frame callbacks.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes; frame-callback scheduling inside the scripted UI bridge is not a controllable operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged; frame-callback scheduling is runtime plumbing, not a design-time capability.
